scope: New research failed-alert readonly projection, control API alert mapping, visible Health history/pagination and directly associated tests

findings.issue: Deeply nested corrupt reason JSON escapes the promised typed unavailable path
findings.evidence: The 4096-character limit still permits roughly 1000 nested arrays. json.loads can raise RecursionError on that metadata before the subsequent list/reason validation. The final exception tuple translates sqlite3.Error/OSError/ValueError/TypeError/KeyError but omits RecursionError. OwnerControlServices.view catches only ResearchQueueError, so this source corruption escapes as an unstructured HTTP500 instead of sanitized503 RESEARCH_ALERT_HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE
findings.minimal_fix: Translate RecursionError to the same bounded ResearchQueueError, or use a depth-bounded decoder for this small reason list. Keep the original reason/time and no-outcome/input decoding behavior unchanged
findings.minimal_regression: Create a genuine failed job through the actual queue/owner failure seam, then corrupt only its reason_codes_json in an isolated test-owned copy to a deeply nested value shorter than4096. Assert the reader raises ResearchQueueError and authenticated GET returns sanitized503 without the private canary. Do not insert a handwritten FAILED terminal row or relax the owned schema

other_static_observations: The reader does not call the writable queue factory, resolver, service factory or migration binder; mode=ro/query_only/trusted_schema=OFF and a bounded query-work/lock budget are present
Schema/namespace/count/page reads occur within one readonly transaction; failed filtering precedes pagination and metadata is selected without input_json or outcome_json
The main DB and existing WAL/SHM companions are checked as ordinary single-link local files, and the main identity is checked again before returning
The API distinguishes configured empty history from unavailable source and derives alert IDs from stable namespace/job/revision/generation rather than GET clock
The Health screen renders actual job/time/source/reason history and reuses the existing error and last-known source disclosure and page controls; React text rendering introduces no raw HTML path
Associated tests use actual enqueue/claim/owner-failure paths and controlled malformed/missing sources; no real provider/LIVE claim is made
